name: The Murder Of Robert Craigh
source:
One of the town's celebrities, Robert Craigh, has been brutally murdered. You are the famous detective Tom Anderson. Can you solve this murder mystery, or will the murderer get away?

[from [url=https://johanofkarlsson.itch.io/the-murder-of-robert-craigh]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
该镇的名人之一罗伯特·克雷格被残酷谋杀。你是著名侦探汤姆·安德森。你能解开这个谋杀之谜吗，还是凶手会逃脱？

[来自[url=https://johanofkarlsson.itch.io/the-murder-of-robert-craigh]itch.io[/url]]
